en.description:
GroceryMatch keeps your grocery list, finds the supermarkets around you and shows real nutrition data for what you buy. It never fills a screen with made-up prices, deals or savings: where it has no real data, it says so.

SHOPPING LIST
Build your list by typing, quick-adding or browsing aisles, and share it with anyone.

STORES NEAR YOU
See the supermarkets around you on a map, with addresses and straight-line distances from OpenStreetMap.

BARCODE LOOKUP
Enter a barcode to identify a product and see its ingredients, allergens and Nutri-Score from Open Food Facts.

HEALTHIER ALTERNATIVES
Search a product type and compare matching products ranked by their published Nutri-Score, with sugar and protein per 100 g.

MEAL PLANNER AND PANTRY
Pick from a week of recipes, add the ingredients to your list in one tap, and keep track of what is already in the cupboard.

BUDGET
Set a monthly grocery budget and keep it in one place.

—— About prices ——

GroceryMatch only shows prices it has fetched from a live store source. When none is available, the Compare and Deals screens say prices are unavailable instead of guessing.

—— No account needed ——

Tap "Continue as Guest" to use the app without an account. Your list is stored on this device.

en.release_notes:
GroceryMatch 2.1.

• Stores near you now come from OpenStreetMap, around your actual location
• Healthier alternatives now use real Nutri-Scores from Open Food Facts
• Budget Coach now uses the budget you set
• Removed screens that showed sample prices, deals, coupons, forecasts and savings instead of real data
• New lists, pantries and craving lists start empty

Feedback is welcome at contact@safecodeg.com.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
GroceryMatch keeps your grocery list, finds the supermarkets around you and shows real nutrition data for what you buy. It never fills a screen with made-up prices, deals or savings: where it has no real data, it says so.

Intended audience:
Grocery lists & nearby stores

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Authentication (Google) — sign-in
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints
- OpenStreetMap (Overpass API) — nearby supermarkets
- Open Food Facts — product and nutrition data
- ipapi.co — approximate location for nearby stores

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
